scope: Audit of all87 inventoried GNU option/operator spellings plus structural interaction families. Automatic performance routing is a measured bounded subset; original GNU covers all other invocations. Finite evidence does not prove every input or hardware has the same speed ordering.

automatic_family.roots: one existing normalized physical ASCII directory
automatic_family.syntax: optional-P; leading mindepth/maxdepth; one-name; optional-type f/d/l; simple AND; implicit-print or final-print/print0
automatic_family.shape: root directory link count34..514; at most8 child-directory link counts project at least24000 second-level directories; sampled child links no larger10000
automatic_family.density: up to8 read-only depth2 GNU samples, at most32768 marker bytes each; each sample at least128 entries and match fraction <=1/128; projected total matches <=32
automatic_family.side_effects: no user actions are sampled or replayed; internal observation outputs and errors never enter user output
automatic_family.cost: policy startup, metadata and sample work included in shipping-entry benchmark
automatic_family.limitations: Link counts and prefix samples are predictors, not a complete recursive size/selectivity census; irregular, changing or differently cached filesystems may change the speed ordering. Existing engine validates ordering/bytes/errors/resource bounds before output.
